1.consolidated_definition: Planta herbácea silvestre, de cuyas hojas se extrae un color rosado y sus frutillas son rojas. Fitolaceae; Rivina humilis.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Wild herbaceous plant, from whose leaves a pink color is extracted and its red berries are produced. Fitolaceae; Rivina humilis.
